name: amfx-yields-vs-crude-research
description: amFX reproduction (16JUN22 p2): US 10-year yields vs NYMEX crude overlay. Bloomberg-style dual-line chart showing the tight co-movement between yields and oil during the 2021-2022 inflation/tightening cycle. Both series z-score normalized for overlay. Brent Donnelly's thesis: aggressive tightening eventually breaks commodity prices and becomes good for bonds.
source:
# =============================================================================
# AMFX REPRODUCTION: US 10Y YIELDS VS NYMEX CRUDE (16JUN22 p2)
# =============================================================================
# Classic macro overlay: yields and oil marching in lockstep during the
# inflation/tightening cycle of 2021-2022. Blue = crude, black = yields.
# The thesis: aggressive tightening eventually breaks commodity prices.
#
# Since we cannot do dual axes, we normalize both series (z-score)
# to show the co-movement on a common scale.
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

crude_close = cont.c

# US 10-Year Yield from FRED (DGS10)
yield_src = economic_indicators(series_id='DGS10')()
yield_10y = ffill(yield_src.result)

idx = index()

# =============================================================================
# Normalize both series for visual overlay
# Z-score with a wide window captures the full range
# =============================================================================
crude_z = zscore(window=200)(crude_close)
yield_z = zscore(window=200)(yield_10y)

# =============================================================================
# CHART 1: Normalized Overlay (Z-Score)
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='Do 10Y Yields and Crude Move in Lockstep During Tightening?',
    category='Yields vs Crude',
    y_axis_label='Z-Score (200d)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='NYMEX Crude (CL)', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='US 10Y Yield (DGS10)', color=Color.Gray)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title='Mean', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=0
)(idx, crude_z, yield_z)
